python_executable.title: Python 3 executable
python_executable.description: Absolute path to a working Python 3.11 or newer interpreter. Cognitive Powers hooks run this file directly. On Windows do not point at the Microsoft Store alias in WindowsApps\python3.exe; it is a stub that fails without installing Python. Verify with: <path> --version
